_instructions: 1. Copy this file to config.json (same directory)
2. Fill in your Gmail address and an App Password (NOT your normal Gmail password)
3. To create a Gmail App Password:
- Enable 2-Step Verification if not already enabled
- Go to App Passwords (search for it in the security page)
- Create a new App Password for 'Mail' on 'Other (Custom name)' — call it 'Art Newsletter'
4. config.json is gitignored — your credentials will never be committed
